title: combineStreams takes two bare strings, so a swapped call site typechecks clean and silently reverses the load-bearing stderr-first ordering
description:
Residue of CAM-368 (PR #298), found by the orchestrator during story verification; review round 1 returned CLEAN without raising it.

CAM-368 extracted `combineStreams(stderr: string, stdout: string): string` in src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts and converted the four failing-step return sites to call it. That successfully gave the JOIN ordering a single definition point, and a direct unit test now pins it (`combineStreams('ERRLINE','OUTLINE').split('\n')[0] === 'ERRLINE'`).

But the ARGUMENT ordering is still per-site and completely unguarded. Both parameters are bare `string`, so a call site written as `combineStreams(checkout.stdout, checkout.stderr)` typechecks cleanly, passes every existing test, and silently reverses the invariant at that one step. Since `detail` reaches the operator through truncatePreflightDetail as FIRST LINE ONLY (src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts:135-139, consumed at src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts:1607), a reversal buries the actual verdict behind banner chatter -- which is the exact failure mode that made the original CAM-363 incident undiagnosable.

So the invariant moved from 'duplicated at 4 sites, pinned at 2' to 'defined once, but re-specified by hand at 4 call sites'. Better, not closed.

PROPOSED FIX (makes the swap unrepresentable rather than merely tested): change the signature to accept the spawn result object directly, e.g. `combineStreams(r: { stdout: string; stderr: string }): string`. All four call sites already have the whole result object in hand (`checkout`, `pull`, `typecheck`, `tests`), so each becomes `combineStreams(checkout)` and there is no argument order left to get wrong. The PlanPreflightSpawnFn return type is already exactly that shape, so the parameter can be typed structurally against it.

IN SCOPE: the signature change, the four call sites (src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts:98,105,125,132), and updating the direct unit tests at test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts:46,50,54,58 to the object form while keeping their strict `toBe` assertions and the stderr-first ordering case.

OUT OF SCOPE: the clean-tree step (still stdout-only by design); loopSpawnFn at src/commands/sidecar.ts, which carries the identical stderr drop and is deferred separately; any change to the required-ness of `stderr` on PlanPreflightSpawnFn.

NOTE: this is a sidecar-executed file, so shipping it requires a coherence rebuild.

spec.scope: Make the reversed-ordering swap in combineStreams (src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts) unrepresentable at the type level by changing its signature from two bare string params (stderr, stdout) to a single object param typed structurally as { stdout: string; stderr: string }, so every call site passes the whole spawn-result object and there is no argument order left to get wrong. Update the four call sites in runPlanPreflight and the four direct unit tests. Out of scope: the stdout-only clean-tree step and the separate loopSpawnFn stderr-drop in src/commands/sidecar.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: combineStreams in src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts takes a single object parameter typed structurally as { stdout: string; stderr: string } (compatible with the PlanPreflightSpawnFn result), not two bare string parameters. [oracle: grep -n 'export function combineStreams' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts shows a single object param on the branch; on unmodified main it shows two bare string params, red-on-main]

All four call sites in runPlanPreflight (checkout, pull, typecheck, tests steps) pass the whole spawn-result object as combineStreams(checkout), combineStreams(pull), combineStreams(typecheck), combineStreams(tests); no call site names a .stderr or .stdout member. [oracle: grep -n 'combineStreams(' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts shows four object-form calls with no member access; on unmodified main all four read combineStreams of X.stderr comma X.stdout, red-on-main]

The stderr-first join ordering is preserved: combineStreams built from an object whose stderr is 'ERRLINE' and stdout is 'OUTLINE' yields 'ERRLINE' as its first line. [oracle: a probe calling combineStreams with that object and reading split-newline index 0 gets 'ERRLINE' on the branch]

The direct unit tests in test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts are updated to the object-argument form while keeping strict toBe assertions and all four cases (stderr-first, stdout-only, stderr-only, both-empty). [oracle: grep -n 'combineStreams(' on the test file shows object-form calls and the describe block still has four it cases; bun test on that file is green on the branch]
typecheck and the full test suite pass. [oracle: bun run typecheck exits zero and bun test is all-green on the branch]
gotchas: src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts is executed by the sidecar at plan time (runPlanPreflight is wired into the production plan phase via preflightFn in src/commands/sidecar.ts); shipping this requires a coherence rebuild before the change takes effect in a running sidecar.

Out of scope: the clean-tree step (git status --porcelain) is stdout-only by design and must not be routed through combineStreams; loopSpawnFn in src/commands/sidecar.ts carries a separate structural stderr-drop and is deferred; do not change the required-ness of stderr on PlanPreflightSpawnFn.
The doc comment above combineStreams explains the stderr-first-survives-truncation rationale; keep it accurate after the signature change: params become one object but stderr still leads the join.

Keep the stderr-first ordering: the join array must remain stderr then stdout, not stdout then stderr; the object destructuring order inside the body is cosmetic but the join array order is load-bearing.
domainTerms: combineStreams: helper in src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts that joins a step stderr and stdout (stderr first) into the single-line-truncated detail surfaced to the operator.
PlanPreflightSpawnFn: the spawn function type returning { stdout: string; stderr: string; exitCode: number }; the new object param of combineStreams is typed structurally against it.
truncatePreflightDetail: consumes detail as FIRST LINE ONLY (src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts), which is why stderr must lead so the verdict is not buried.
